items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: He would be sort of like a Milton Berle thing. Yeah, he was sort of a comedian.

ctx.x: I remember that but I can't remember.

Yeah, because Dave, I believe the guy's name was Dave Cavanaugh, Dave or something. Yeah, he was a tenor, alto player. Yeah, right. He came down, he didn't play though, he just came and directed. Yeah. Well, produced it in our session. We made it at the same Cosmo Studios. Right. Cosmo hadn't moved yet from off, off, off, off, off, off. And Joe Jones was working at this place where I was working. We were loading, Stevens Band, Paper Company. We were loading trucks up all day with supplies like toilet paper, paper…
